title: Door Latch Mortise Jig for Router, Red Aluminium Door Installation Kit with Router Bit, Self-Centring Drill Bit, Double-Ended Driver and Hex Key, for 1 x 2-1/4 in Latch Plates
bullets: FOR LATCH FACEPLATE RECESSES: This door latch mortise jig provides a routing template for timber door latch installation. The faceplate size shown on the jig is 1 x 2-1/4 in. Check your latch dimensions and intended cut before starting; it is not a template for a full lock-body mortise.

CHECK DOOR COMPATIBILITY: The supplier lists compatibility with wooden doors 1-3/8 in or 1-3/4 in thick (approximately 34.9 or 44.5 mm). Match your door thickness, latch plate and tool setup before use. Intended for door-edge latch faceplates rather than door-frame strike plates.

RED ALUMINIUM CONSTRUCTION: An aluminium alloy body with a red finish forms the guide, with four black top screws and a rectangular routing aperture. The black adjustment knob turns a threaded clamp with an internal pressure pad. Adjust the fit and check the jig is secure before routing.

ONE JIG AND FOUR ACCESSORIES: The photographed kit includes one red mortise jig, a yellow-tipped router bit, a silver self-centring drill bit, a double-ended screwdriver bit and an L-shaped hex key. Confirm accessory shanks and tool compatibility. Router, drill and door hardware are not included.

PREPARE, ADJUST AND TEST: Check the latch, clamp position and routing depth before cutting, and test your setup on suitable scrap timber. Body dimensions supplied by the seller are 8 x 8 x 5 cm, excluding accessories. Follow the instructions for your router, drill and latch hardware.
